However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C SrDFM/NCR/JHS . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction

of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Sr.DFM//NCR/JHS payable at Sr.DSTE/Co./JHS . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF WORK 1. Scope of Work: The contractor shall provide one skilled and one semi-skilled person at each station. 2. Deployment of Manpower: The contractor shall deploy a total of 10 skilled and 10 semi-skilled persons, subject to the approved tender schedule. The personnel shall remain available at their respective stations and shall perform duties as dir ected by the authorized Railway representative. 3. Qualification and Experience: Skilled personnel shall possess ITI/Diploma or other relevant technical qualifications in the appropriate trade, as specified in the tender. Semi-skilled personnel shall possess the minimum educational qualificati on specified in the tender and shall be capable of assisting skilled personnel in maintenance activities. 4. Maintenance Activities: The deployed team shall assist Railway S&T staff in maintenance, upkeep and failure attentio n of Point Machines, Track Circuits, Signals, Axle Counters, cables, batteries, chargers, transformers, location boxes and ot her S&T equipment, as directed by the authorized Railway representative. 5. Safety Precautions: All work shall be carried out under the supervision and authorization of Railway officials. The contr actor's personnel shall strictly follow applicable Railway safety rules, instructions and precautions while working near railw ay tracks, points, signals and other operational installations. No safety-critical operation shall be undertaken independentl y by the contractor's personnel. 6. Tools and Equipment: The contractor shall arrange, at its own cost, the necessary tools, tackles, personal protective e quipment (PPE), uniforms and other items required for the work, except materials specifically agreed to be supplied by the Railway under the contract. 7. Communication Facility: The contractor shall provide each team with a functioning mobile phone and ensure effective communication with the concerned SSE/JE/S&T staff and the authorized Railway representative. Contact details of deploye d personnel shall be furnished before commencement of work. 8. Attendance and Supervision: The contractor shall maintain daily attendance and station-wise deployment records. These records shall be verified by the authorized Railway representative before certification of the monthly service perfor mance and processing of bills. 9. Replacement of Personnel: In case of absence, resignation, leave or unsatisfactory performance of any deployed pers on, the contractor shall arrange a suitable replacement within the period prescribed in the contract. Any applicable penalty for non-deployment or delayed replacement shall be imposed Rs.1000/- per person or the competent authority wil l be decide. 10. Minimum Wages and Statutory Payments: The contractor shall pay wages not less than the applicable minimum wages notified by the competent Government authority. EPF, ESI, bonus, leave wages and other statutory benefits shall be paid wherever applicable. Documentary proof of wage payment and statutory remittances shall be submitted as requir ed by the contract. 11. Bank Payment of Wages: Wages shall be paid directly into the bank accounts of the deployed personnel through the p rescribed banking channel. 12. Weekly Rest and Leave Relief: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for weekly rest, leave and other absences in accordance with applicable labour laws and the approved manpower requirement. No additional payment shal l be admissible for such arrangements unless specifically provided in the contract. 13. Identity Cards and Verification: Before deployment, the contractor shall submit the list of personnel along with identit y proof, address proof, qualification certificates and medical fitness documents, as required under the contract. Police veri fication shall be furnished wherever stipulated. All personnel shall carry valid contractor-issued identity cards while on Rail way premises. 14. Uniform and Discipline: The contractor shall ensure that all deployed personnel wear the prescribed uniform and identi ty badge, maintain proper discipline and comply with the instructions of authorized Railway officials. Any personnel found unsuitable, negligent or guilty of misconduct shall be replaced as per the contract conditions. 15. Emergency Duties: In the event of an S&T failure or emergency, the team shall assist Railway staff at the locations specified by the competent authority, subject to the scope of work and applicable safety procedures. Any movement beyo nd the specified stations shall be governed by the contract provisions and instructions of the competent authority. 16. Transportation and Accommodation: The contractor shall make its own arrangements for transportation, accommoda tion, food and other facilities for its personnel. No free transport, accommodation or other personal facilities shall be provi ded by the Railway unless specifically provided in the contract. 17. Protection of Railway Property: The contractor shall be responsible for loss or damage to Railway property attributabl e to the negligence or misconduct of its personnel, subject to assessment and recovery in accordance with the applicable

contract conditions and rules.1. Labour Law Compliance: The contractor shall comply with the applicable labour la ws, statutory registrations, working-hour requirements, weekly rest provisions and other statutory obligations. The contractor shall be responsible for its employees and for maintaining all prescribed employment and wage records. 2. No Employer-Employee Relationship: The personnel deployed by the contractor shall remain employees of the contr actor. Their deployment shall not create any employer-employee relationship with Indian Railways or confer any right to re gular employment or absorption in Railway service. 3. Subletting: The contractor shall not assign or sublet the contract, wholly or partly, without prior written permission wh erever required under the applicable GCC and contract conditions. 4. Inspection and Performance Monitoring: The Railway administration may inspect attendance, deployment, tools, sa fety compliance and the quality of assistance provided by the contractor's personnel. Deficiencies shall be rectified within the time stipulated by the authorized Railway representative. 5. Payment of Bills: Payment shall be made in accordance with the GeM contract terms against satisfactory performance , certification by the authorized Railway representative and submission of prescribed bills, attendance records, wage-pay ment proof and applicable statutory compliance documents. 6. Penalty for Deficiency: Penalties and recoveries for non-deployment, unauthorized absence, delayed replacement, un satisfactory performance or other contractual deficiencies shall be governed by the applicable GeM SLA, GCC and approve d tender conditions. 7. Applicable Conditions: These Special Conditions shall be read together with the approved GeM bid, scope of work, GC C for Services, applicable SLA and relevant Railway instructions. Rules Will be applicable. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) The following eligibility criteria and conditions shall be applicable for technical evaluation of the bid for maintenance support services of Sign al & Telecommunication (S&T) outdoor gears under Jhansi Division, North Central Railway. 1. Financial Turnover The bidder shall have an average annual financial turnover of not less than 150% of the advertised tender value, as prescribed under GCC for Services, 2018, Para 2.6.1.2, subject to the applicable tender provisions. The turnover shall be supported by audited financial statements and a certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA), duly indicating the membership number and UDIN, wherever applicable. 2. Past Experience of Similar Services As per GCC for Services, 2018, Para 2.6.1.1, and the applicable GeM bid conditions, the bidder shall have successfully completed similar servi ces during the current financial year and the preceding three financial years ending in March prior to the bid opening date. The required expe rience shall be fulfilled by any one of the following: i. Three similar completed services, each costing not less than 40% of the advertised tender value; or ii. Two similar completed services, each costing not less than 50% of the advertised tender value; or iii. One similar completed service costing not less than 80% of the advertised tender value. The bidder shall upload valid work orders/contracts along with completion certificates issued by the competent authority/client. The documen ts must clearly indicate the nature of work, contract value, period of execution and successful completion of the work. 3. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) As per Service GCC, Clause 3.3, Para 3.3.1, and the applicable GeM bid conditions, the bidder shall submit EMD at the rate of 2% of the adver tised tender value, wherever stipulated in the bid. Exemption, if any, shall be allowed strictly in accordance with the applicable GeM provisions and Railway instructions. The bidder claiming ex emption shall upload valid supporting documents establishing eligibility for the exemption. 4. Definition of Similar Nature of Work

Similar nature of work shall mean maintenance support services involving maintenance of S&T outdoor gears and equipment, including but n ot limited to Signal gears, Point Machines, Track Circuits, Axle Counters and other related S&T equipment. The definition of similar nature of work shall be governed by Dy. CSTE/P&D-I/NCR letter No. NCR/S&T/4019/Works/Similar Nature of Work/Part -4 dated 15.10.2024. The bidder shall submit experience certificates clearly establishing execution of work of the specified similar nature. Ex perience certificates relating to unrelated services shall not be considered. 5. Declaration Regarding Blacklisting/Debarment The bidder shall submit a duly signed and dated declaration regarding blacklisting, debarment or banning by any Government Department, P ublic Sector Undertaking, Indian Railways or other competent authority, as required by the bid conditions. The declaration shall bear the name of the bidder/authorized signatory and, wherever required, the GeM Bid Number. Any false declaration or suppression of material facts shall be dealt with as per applicable rules and contract conditions. 6. Acceptance of ATC and Special Conditions The bidder shall upload the duly signed and dated acceptance of all applicable Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), scope of work, technic al requirements and Special Conditions of Contract. The acceptance shall clearly identify the relevant GeM Bid Number and shall be signed by the proprietor, partner or duly authorized signatory . All documents specifically required to be signed or accepted under the bid shall be submitted accordingly. 7. Legal Status and Constitution of the Firm The bidder shall clearly specify its legal status, such as Proprietorship, Partnership Firm, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), Company or other legally recognized entity, and upload the relevant registration/incorporation documents. In the case of a partnership firm, the bidder shall submit the partnership deed, registration certificate wherever applicable, details of partners and authorization of the signatory. Documents shall be duly authenticated/notarized wherever legally required or specifically stipulated in the bid. In the case of a company or LLP, the relevant incorporation certificate and authorization of the person signing the bid shall be submitted. 8. Registration and Statutory Documents The bidder shall submit applicable registrations and certificates, including PAN, GST registration, EPF and ESI registration, and labour licence/r egistration wherever required under applicable law and the nature of the contract. Where a particular registration or licence is not applicable at the bidding stage, the bidder shall furnish an appropriate declaration, subject to t he applicable legal requirements and bid conditions. 10. Compliance with Labour Laws and Statutory Obligations The successful bidder shall comply with GCC for Services, 2018, Para 6.2, and all applicable labour laws, rules and statutory provisions in forc e, including the applicable provisions relating to: i. Payment of minimum wages and timely payment of wages. ii. Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees' State Insurance (ESI), wherever applicable. iii. Working hours, weekly rest, overtime and other applicable employment conditions. v. Maintenance of wage registers, attendance records, employment records and other statutory registers. vi. Compliance with applicable provisions of the labour codes and the corresponding existing enactments/rules to the extent in force. The successful bidder shall submit the prescribed proof of statutory compliance along with the relevant bills/invoices or whenever demanded by the Railway administration. 11. Minimum Wages and Price Quotation. The bidder shall quote its rates after duly considering the applicable minimum wages, statutory contributions, leave benefits, bonus wherever payable, and all other applicable statutory liabilities. or other established contractual defaults. 12. Penalty for Deficiency in Service. In the event of non-deployment of required manpower, unauthorized absence, unsatisfactory performance, failure to comply with safety instru ctions or other deficiencies, penalties/recoveries shall be imposed strictly in accordance with the applicable Service GCC, GeM contract, Servic e Level Agreement (SLA) and the penalty will be decided by competent authority. C. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS FOR TECHNICAL EVALUATION The bidder shall upload the following documents, as applicable to the bidder and specifically required under the bid: 1. Audited financial statements and CA-certified turnover certificate. 2. Work orders/contracts and completion certificates for similar services. 3. EMD proof or valid exemption documents, as applicable. 4. Signed declaration regarding blacklisting/debarment.

5. Signed and dated acceptance of ATC and Special Conditions. 6. Proof of legal status and constitution of the firm. 7. PAN and GST registration documents, as applicable. 8. EPF/ESI registration and applicable labour licence/registration documents, or the prescribed declaration where legally permissible. 9. Any other document specifically required under the GeM bid and applicable Railway instructions. Note: The above documents shall be examined during technical evaluation. Non-submission of an essential document or failure to meet a mandatory eligibility criterion may result in rejection of the bid, subject to the applicable GeM provisions and tender conditi ons. Clarifications or additional documents shall be sought only were permitted under the applicable rules. The above conditions shall be read in conjunction with the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions, Service-specific Terms and Conditio ns, Service GCC, SLA and the approved scope of work. In the event of any inconsistency, the applicable contractual provisions and prevailing Railway/GeM instructions shall govern. . 11. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 12. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 13. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
